# Budgeting with envelopes

Give every dollar a job. An envelope holds a target amount for a category of
spending, and you assign money to it every month.

## Assigning money

Open the Plan tab and assign money from Ready to Assign into an envelope. You
can move money between envelopes without touching the ledger.

## Rollover

An envelope can carry its leftover balance into next month, or reset to zero
at the start of each month — your choice, per envelope.
